query:
SELECT m.name, json_extract(selected.value, '$[1]') AS "address?: String",
            COUNT(*) AS count
        FROM json_each(?) selected
        JOIN mentor m ON m.id = json_extract(selected.value, '$[0]')
        JOIN email e ON e.mentor_id = m.id
        WHERE e.state = 'approved'
        GROUP BY m.id
        ORDER BY m.id
